# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. Your `robots.txt` tells every crawler to stay out of the whole site, and the pages only fill in after JavaScript runs. Together those are the main reasons the score is low. The one unknown is the canonical link (GEO-015), because no site address is declared. All results are read from code, and no live check was run. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking all crawlers in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` asks every search and AI-search crawler not to read any page, so nothing else you fix can be found. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:2` - **What the code says:** `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59 (GEO-009 and GEO-014 both become Clear). This assumes you want to be found, since there is no `geo.config.json` to say otherwise. If the block is deliberate, e.g. a staging site, tell me and I'll treat it as a policy choice. ### 2. Put the page content in the HTML the server sends - **Why it matters:** Many crawlers don't run JavaScript. They would see an empty page, and the catalogue is fetched only in the browser. - **Where:** `index.html:8` and `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6` - **What the code says:** `
` and `fetch('/api/mugs').then((r) => r.json()).then(setItems);` - **Size:** Large (prerender or server-render the routes, e.g. build-time prerendering or an SSR framework) - **Score after this:** 37–46 (GEO-003 becomes Clear) ### 3. Add a sitemap, a page title and description, and `lang` - **Why it matters:** The sitemap lists the pages you want found. Every page currently has the title "Vite App", with no description and no declared language. - **Where:** `index.html:2` and `index.html:5`. There is no sitemap file anywhere. - **What the code says:** `` and `Vite App` - **Size:** Small to Medium. Per-page titles and descriptions need a head manager, and each page gets its own text. - **Score after this:** 41–50 (GEO-011 and GEO-012 become Clear). A `Sitemap:` line also needs to be added to `robots.txt`. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and reachable | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt`, 2 valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access you intend | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2` `Disallow: /` under `User-agent: *` (assumed you want to be found) | | GEO-014 | Linked pages are indexable | Problem | Not run | Both routes are blocked for Googlebot and Bingbot by `public/robots.txt:1-2`. No noindex found. | | GEO-015 | One absolute canonical on your own domain | Can't tell | Not run | No canonical in `index.html:3-6`, and no site address is declared | | GEO-003 | Content is in the server HTML | Problem | Not run | `index.html:8`, `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6`. Both routes are client-rendered. | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and is linked from robots.txt | Problem | Not run | No sitemap file, and no `Sitemap:` line in `public/robots.txt` | | GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` | Problem | Not run | `index.html:2` has no `lang`, `index.html:5` has `Vite App`, and there is no description. Both routes share this. | | GEO-016 | Pages are reachable by real links | Problem | Not run | `src/main.jsx:11`: Catalogue is reached only via a button. Home needs no link. | | GEO-017 | No snippet restrictions | Clear | Not run | No `nosnippet` or `max-snippet` in `index.html` or any source file. No middleware or headers config. | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Problem | Not run | `src/pages/Home.jsx:5` has an image with no `alt` (1 of 2 routes). I read `Home.jsx`, `Catalogue.jsx` and `Nav`. | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (information only) | Not applicable | Not run | Not present. Not scored. | | GEO-102 | App structured data (information only) | Not applicable | Not run | Not an app. Not scored. | ## Other problems found - **Placeholder title:** `index.html:5`: `Vite App`. Give each page a real title. ## Worth considering - **Give the mug list real pages:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11`: `{items.map((m) =>

{m.name}

)}`. Each mug is plain text with no link. A page and address per mug (e.g. `/mugs/`) would let it be found on its own, and could carry Product structured data. - **Describe the hero image:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:5`: ``. Add `alt` text. The image may be where your visitors first see what the mugs look like. - **Say more about the product in text:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:6`: `Thrown by hand in Bristol and shipped worldwide.` A visitor would likely want to know prices, sizes, materials and shipping costs. None of these appear anywhere as text. - **Add `viewport` to the head:** `index.html:4`: ``. It is the only meta tag, and a viewport tag helps pages render properly on phones. ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-015 canonical:** no site address is declared. Tell me your domain, e.g. via `site.origin` in `geo.config.json`, and I can settle it. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Unlisted routes:** `/api/mugs` returns data I can't see, so I can't list the catalogue items. ## Assumptions - You want search and AI-search tools to find this site, and `Disallow: /` is not a deliberate staging block. - Only two routes exist (`/` and `/catalogue`), and I checked both. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
